literal: On renxu day, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On renxu day the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.

literal: On xinwei day, the officials requested making the Emperor's birthday the Thousand-Age Festival; it was approved.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the authorities petitioned to designate the Emperor's birthday as the Thousand-Age Festival, and the request was granted.

literal: The Empress Dowager said that the late yuyue Wuzhi had only the merit of instructing and guiding and that his descendants ought to be recorded;
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager said that the late yuyue Wuzhi had earned merit chiefly as tutor and guide and that his descendants deserved recognition;

literal: His son Panyang was then appointed linyal.
idiomatic: His son Panyang was accordingly appointed linyal.

literal: On bingzi day, he went to Old Man River.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the Emperor went to Old Man River.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on guiwei day the new moon, the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the Old Man star appeared.
idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the Directorate of Astronomy reported the appearance of the Old Man star.

literal: On wuzi day, Princess Shuge was given in marriage below to the Empress's brother xiangwen Zhaogu.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Princess Shuge was married to the Empress's brother, xiangwen Zhaogu.

literal: On guisi day, Susa memorialized that the Dilie division and rebel tribes had surrendered and all former territory was recovered.
idiomatic: On guisi day Susa reported that the Dilie division and rebellious tribes had submitted and that all lost territory had been recovered.

literal: On yiwei day, on the word of yuyue Xiuge, Yanjing regent, that each year the military commissioners' tribute, following Khitan official precedent, should only present saddles and horses; it was approved.
idiomatic: On yiwei day, acting on memorial from yuyue Xiuge, regent of Yanjing, that circuit commissioners should follow Khitan precedent and present only saddles and horses as annual tribute, the court agreed.

literal: On dingyou day, Prince of Wu Shao was made Supreme Capital regent and acted as Linhuang intendant.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Prince of Wu Shao was appointed regent of the Supreme Capital and acted concurrently as intendant of Linhuang.

literal: The Emperor was about to campaign against Goryeo and personally reviewed the troops under Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie.
idiomatic: Preparing to campaign against Goryeo, the Emperor personally inspected the forces under Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie.

literal: On bingwu day, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants and concurrent Palace Attendant Pulie, linyal Kend, and others were ordered to lead troops east in punitive campaign; drums, banners, and silver tally-seals were granted.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Pulie, commissioner of the Palace Attendants and concurrent Palace Attendant, Kend the linyal, and others were ordered east with an expeditionary force and were granted campaign drums, banners, and silver tally-seals.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi day the new moon, fishing was observed at Tama Marsh.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the eleventh month the court watched the fishing at Tama Marsh.

literal: On guichou day, Yingzhou memorialized that a Song spy had been captured who said Song was clearing a road at Mount Wutai and would enter Lingqiu territory.
idiomatic: On guichou day Yingzhou reported the capture of a Song spy who said Song was opening a route at Mount Wutai and would enter the Lingqiu frontier.

literal: An edict ordered the spy and those who harbored him all dismembered at the market.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the spy and those who had sheltered him torn apart by carts in the marketplace.

literal: On gengchen day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager sacrificed at Qian Mausoleum and issued an edict instructing the left and right chancellors of the three capitals, left and right co-chancellors, deputy regents and administrative assistants, military commissioners' assistants of all circuits, military affairs assistants, recording secretaries, and others that they should uphold public rectitude and not cringe and comply.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor and Empress Dowager sacrificed at Qian Mausoleum and issued an edict to the chancellors, vice-regents, circuit and army staff, and recording secretaries of the three capitals, directing them to govern with impartial integrity and not to flatter and yield.

literal: When county magistrates and assistants meet unreasonable demands from prefectural officials or court envoys, they must not fear and comply.
idiomatic: County magistrates and assistants who encounter unlawful exactions from prefectural officials or imperial envoys must not give way out of fear.

literal: They shall constantly gather intelligence, using it to grade performance.
idiomatic: They were to keep constant watch and use what they learned to rank officials for promotion and demotion.

literal: Among the people, those who have living parents yet separate registers and live apart, let neighbors report them and they shall be punished.
idiomatic: Commoners who kept separate households while their parents still lived were to be reported by neighbors and punished.

literal: Those filial toward parents and living together for three generations, their gates and lanes shall be honored.
idiomatic: Families noted for filial piety and three generations living together were to have their gates and lanes publicly honored.

literal: In the twelfth month, on renwu day the new moon, he visited Ningshen Hall, dispatched envoys to sacrifice separately at the various mausoleums, and granted wine to the officials guarding the halls.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited Ningshen Hall, sent envoys to offer sacrifice at the various mausoleums, and granted wine to the officials who guarded the halls.

literal: That day, he visited Xian Prefecture.
idiomatic: That day the Emperor visited Xian Prefecture.

literal: On dinghai day, the annual tribute of silk brocade from Xian Prefecture was divided and granted to the left and right.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the annual tribute of silk brocade from Xian Prefecture was divided and distributed to the left and right offices.

literal: On jiawu day, he traveled east.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor traveled east.

literal: On yihai day, the Empress Dowager watched fishing at Jade Basin Bay.
idiomatic: On yihai day the Empress Dowager watched the fishing at Jade Basin Bay.

literal: On xinchou day, fishing was observed at Junyuan.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the court watched the fishing at Junyuan.

literal: On jiachen day, an edict ordered that in criminal cases already concluded and sentenced, if there is injustice, one may appeal to the censorate.
idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict allowed those who believed themselves wrongfully convicted in cases already decided and sentenced to appeal to the censorate.

literal: That evening, ten thousand fish lanterns were lit at Twin Streams.
idiomatic: That evening ten thousand fish lanterns were lit at Twin Streams.

literal: On wushen day, the Thousand-Age Festival; the sun and moon were sacrificed to; when the rites were complete, the hundred officials offered congratulations.
idiomatic: On wushen day, the Thousand-Age Festival, the court sacrificed to the sun and moon, and when the rites were finished the hundred officials offered congratulations.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiazi day, he went to Chang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second year, on jiazi day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.

literal: In the second month, on guisi day, Empress's brother's branch Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan came to court.
idiomatic: On guisi day in the second month Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan of the Empress's brother's branch came to court.

literal: On jiawu day, General Yelü Dibu was granted spring garments and a girdle.
idiomatic: On jiawu day General Yelü Dibu was granted spring garments and a girdle.

literal: On bingshen day, Eastern Route field commander and Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Yelü Puning memorialized victory over the Jurchen; envoys were dispatched to clasp hands and commend him.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Eastern Route field commander and commissioner of the Palace Attendants Yelü Puning reported victory over the Jurchen, and envoys were sent to clasp his hands in praise.

literal: On gengzi day, he attended upon the Empress Dowager; the Empress Dowager then followed to watch the hunt at Raole River.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager, who then accompanied him to watch the hunt at Raole River.

literal: On yisi day, Five States Wuyu Wujue Military Commissioner Yelü Kuiwa, because the tribes under his jurisdiction were hard to govern, requested an edict granting a sword to act at discretion; it was approved.
idiomatic: On yisi day Five States Wuyu Wujue Military Commissioner Yelü Kuiwa, finding the tribes under his command difficult to govern, petitioned for an edict and sword granting discretionary authority, and the request was granted.

literal: On bingwu day, the Emperor and the princes and great ministers competed in archery.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor and the princes and great ministers held an archery contest.

literal: On dingwei day, Han Dewei, returning from campaigning against the Tangut, then raided Hedong and presented captives; an edict of praise was granted.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Han Dewei, returning from the Tangut campaign, raided Hedong and presented prisoners; an edict commending him was issued.

literal: In the third month, on maoyin day, the Huali division requested that henceforth xiangwen posts be appointed only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "For officials among the divisions, what matters is getting the right men — how can appointment be fixed by division alone.
idiomatic: On maoyin day in the third month the Huali division petitioned that xiangwen posts should henceforth be filled only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "Officials among the tribes must be chosen for ability — how can appointments be fixed by tribal limits alone.

literal: " The request was denied.
idiomatic: " The petition was denied.

literal: The late co-chancellor Zhao Yanxu was posthumously granted the additional title of Palace Attendant.
idiomatic: The late co-chancellor Zhao Yanxu was posthumously granted the additional rank of Palace Attendant.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on dinghai day, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants and co-chancellor Yelü Puning and overseer Xiao Qinde presented victory over the Jurchen; Puning was made concurrent Chief Councillor, Qinde Grand General of the Divine Martial Guard, and each was granted gold vessels and other goods.
idiomatic: On dinghai day in the fourth summer month commissioner of the Palace Attendants and co-chancellor Yelü Puning and overseer Xiao Qinde reported victory over the Jurchen; Puning was made concurrent chief councillor, Qinde grand general of the Divine Martial Guard, and each received gold vessels and other gifts.

literal: On gengyin day, the Empress Dowager personally decided delayed cases.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the Empress Dowager personally adjudicated delayed cases.

literal: On xinmao day, the Wind Lord was sacrificed to.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court sacrificed to the Wind Lord.

literal: On renchen day, Southern Palace Attendants Commissioner Liu Chenggui was made Chengde Army Military Commissioner, and Chongde Palace Chief Deployer and Baoyi Army Military Commissioner Zhang Deyun was made Northern Palace Attendants Commissioner.
idiomatic: On renchen day Southern Palace Attendants Commissioner Liu Chenggui was appointed Chengde Army military commissioner, and Chongde Palace chief deployer and Baoyi Army Military Commissioner Zhang Deyun was appointed Northern Palace Attendants Commissioner.

literal: In the fifth month, on maoyin day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On maoyin day in the fifth month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: On dingchou day, the court halted at Willow Lake along the route.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the court encamped at Willow Lake along the route.

literal: In the sixth month, on jimao day the new moon, the Empress Dowager decided cases, continuing until the month's end.
idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the sixth month the Empress Dowager held court to decide cases and continued through the end of the month.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on guichou day, the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.
idiomatic: On guichou day in the seventh autumn month the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.

literal: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Palace Attendant Yelü Mojie memorialized that Jurchen chiefs Jubuzhi, Saili, and seven other clans requested to bring their people in submission; an edict ordered them received.
idiomatic: On xinmao day in the eighth month Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Palace Attendant Yelü Mojie reported that the Jurchen chiefs Jubuzhi, Saili, and seven other clans wished to bring their people in submission, and an edict ordered them received.

literal: In the ninth month, on wushen day the new moon, the court halted at Tu River.
idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the ninth month the court encamped at Tu River.

literal: On xinwei day, because it was Jingzong's death anniversary, an edict ordered all circuits and capital garrisons to dispatch officials to burn incense and feed monks.
idiomatic: On xinwei day, Jingzong's death anniversary, an edict ordered every circuit and capital garrison to send officials to burn incense and feed the monks.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on dingchou day the new moon, Guihua Prefecture Military Commissioner Yelü Puning was made Zhangde Army Military Commissioner, and Right Martial Guard Grand General Han Zhuo was made Zhangguo Army Military Commissioner and concurrent commander of the Palace Guard cavalry and infantry.
idiomatic: On the dingchou new moon of the tenth winter month Guihua Prefecture Military Commissioner Yelü Puning was appointed Zhangde Army military commissioner, and Right Martial Guard Grand General Han Zhuo was appointed Zhangguo Army military commissioner and concurrent commander of the Palace Guard cavalry and infantry.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi day, Secretariat Direct Academician and Supervising Secretary Zheng Gu was made Ruzhou prefect.
idiomatic: On renzi day in the eleventh month Secretariat direct academician and supervising secretary Zheng Gu was appointed prefect of Ruzhou.

literal: That month, Susa and others campaigned against the Zubu and killed their chieftain Talagan.
idiomatic: That month Susa and others campaigned against the Zubu and killed their chieftain Talagan.

literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, Hanlin Academician Director Ma Dechen was made Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode was made Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yao was promoted to Great Inner tithen, and Darenjing was made Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
idiomatic: On xinchou day in the twelfth month Hanlin academician director Ma Dechen was appointed Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yao promoted to Great Inner tithen, and Darenjing Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on bingwu day the new moon, he went to Chang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the third year, on the bingwu new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.

literal: On dingsi day, Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu was made Minister of Rites, Vice Minister, and drafter of edicts; Left Reminder and drafter of edicts Liu Jing and Ministry of Personnel Bureau Director and drafter of edicts Niu Cangyong were both made Administrative Secretaries.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Hanlin academician Xing Baopu was appointed Minister of Rites, vice minister, and drafter of edicts; left reminder and drafter of edicts Liu Jing and Ministry of Personnel bureau director and drafter of edicts Niu Cangyong were both made administrative secretaries.

literal: In the second month, on bingzi day the new moon, Niu Cangyong was made acting Secretariat Direct Academician.
idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the second month Niu Cangyong was appointed acting Secretariat direct academician.

literal: In the third month, on yisi day the new moon, the Secretariat memorialized that many Khitan corvée households were impoverished and requested that wealthy households replace them.
idiomatic: On the yisi new moon of the third month the Secretariat reported that many Khitan corvée households were destitute and petitioned that wealthy households be substituted in their place.

literal: The Emperor thereupon reviewed the registers of the various divisions; the Niela and Wuyu divisions had few households yet heavy corvée, and both were partially exempted.
idiomatic: The Emperor then reviewed the registers of the various divisions, found that the Niela and Wuyu divisions had few households but heavy corvée burdens, and partially exempted both.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on yihai day the new moon, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: On the yihai new moon of the fourth summer month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: On renwu day, Fengzhou Prefect Zhao Kuangfu was made Baojing Army Military Commissioner.
idiomatic: On renwu day Fengzhou Prefect Zhao Kuangfu was appointed Baojing Army military commissioner.

literal: On guiwei day, Left Gate Guard Grand General Wang Tingxu was made Fengxian Army Military Commissioner, and Zhangwu Army Military Commissioner Han Dening was made Chongyi Army Military Commissioner.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Left Gate Guard Grand General Wang Tingxu was appointed Fengxian Army military commissioner, and Zhangwu Army Military Commissioner Han Dening was appointed Chongyi Army military commissioner.

literal: In the fifth month, on renzi day, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On renzi day in the fifth month the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.

literal: On guiyou day, the Empress's brother Xiao Daoning was made co-chancellor and given charge of Shenzhou military and civil affairs.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the Empress's brother Xiao Daoning was appointed co-chancellor and put in charge of Shenzhou military and civil affairs.

literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu day the new moon, he went to Baipo.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the sixth month the Emperor went to Baipo.

literal: The Empress Dowager personally decided delayed cases.
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager personally adjudicated delayed cases.

literal: On yihai day, Guiyi Army Military Commissioner Wang Xiyan was made Xingguo Army Military Commissioner.
idiomatic: On yihai day Guiyi Army Military Commissioner Wang Xiyan was appointed Xingguo Army military commissioner.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day the new moon, an edict ordered all circuits to repair armor and weapons in preparation for the eastern campaign against Goryeo.
idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered every circuit to repair armor and weapons in preparation for the eastern campaign against Goryeo.

literal: On jiayin day, he traveled east.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor traveled east.

literal: On jiazi day, the langjun corps was dispatched to grant burial goods to Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the langjun corps was dispatched to grant burial goods to Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.

literal: On bingyin day, the court halted at Tu River.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the court encamped at Tu River.

literal: Because of sudden flooding, he ordered a boat-bridge built; the next day he went out in a palanquin to hear government.
idiomatic: Because of sudden flooding he ordered a boat-bridge built, and the next day went out in a palanquin to hold court.

literal: The Old Man star appeared.
idiomatic: The Old Man star appeared.

literal: On dingmao day, envoys were dispatched to inspect the weapons of the Eastern Capital armies and the roads for the eastern campaign.
idiomatic: On dingmao day envoys were sent to inspect the weapons of the Eastern Capital armies and the routes for the eastern campaign.

literal: Co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was made Zhaode Army Military Commissioner; Wuding Army Military Commissioner, acting Minister of Works and concurrent Chief Councillor Guo Xi was made Tianping Army Military Commissioner; Datong Army Military Commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and concurrent Chief Councillor Liu Yangou was made Yicheng Army Military Commissioner; the late honored father Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was posthumously granted Director of the Department of State Affairs.
idiomatic: Co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was appointed Zhaode Army military commissioner; Wuding Army Military Commissioner, acting Minister of Works and concurrent chief councillor Guo Xi was appointed Tianping Army military commissioner; Datong Army Military Commissioner, acting grand preceptor of the heir apparent and concurrent chief councillor Liu Yangou was appointed Yicheng Army military commissioner; and the late honored father Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was posthumously granted director of the Department of State Affairs.

literal: In the eighth month, on guiyou day the new moon, because Liao's marshes were waterlogged, the campaign against Goryeo was halted.
idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon of the eighth month, because Liao's marshes were waterlogged, the campaign against Goryeo was called off.

literal: Secretariat Commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was ordered as commander-in-chief and Imperial Son-in-law Commander Xiao Kende as army supervisor to lead troops against the Jurchen.
idiomatic: Secretariat Commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was named commander-in-chief and imperial son-in-law commander Xiao Kende army supervisor and ordered to lead troops against the Jurchen.

literal: On dingchou day, he halted at Gaocheng.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the court halted at Gaocheng.

literal: On gengchen day, he reached Xian Prefecture and visited Ningshen Hall.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor reached Xian Prefecture and visited Ningshen Hall.

literal: On xinsi day, he visited Qian Prefecture and viewed the new palace.
idiomatic: On xinsi day he visited Qian Prefecture and viewed the new palace.

literal: On guiwei day, he visited Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On guiwei day the Emperor visited Qian Mausoleum.

literal: On jiashen day, he ordered southern and northern court officials to inspect separately the mountain-mausoleum forests, and ordered Qian and Xian prefectures to submit the numbers of their subordinate villages and communities.
idiomatic: On jiashen day he ordered southern and northern court officials to inspect the mountain-mausoleum forests separately and directed Qian and Xian prefectures to submit counts of their subordinate villages and communities.

literal: On bingxu day, Northern Pishi xiangwen presented seven brave warriors.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Northern Pishi xiangwen presented seven brave warriors.

literal: On wuzi day, the widow of the late Southern Court Great King Xieling Yiliwan, Lady Xiao, memorialized that her husband had died and could not be buried; an edict ordered the authorities to assist.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the widow of the late Southern Court Great King Xieling Yiliwan, Lady Xiao, memorialized that her husband had died and could not be buried, and an edict ordered the authorities to assist.

literal: On gengchen day, the eastern campaign commander-in-chief memorialized that the roads were still mired and advance was not yet possible; an edict ordered waiting until the marshes dried to push deep inward.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the eastern campaign commander-in-chief reported that the roads were still boggy and advance was not yet possible; an edict ordered the army to wait until the marshes dried before pushing deep inland.

literal: On guisi day, the Empress Dowager visited Xian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On guisi day the Empress Dowager visited Xian Mausoleum.

literal: On gengzi day, he visited Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the Emperor visited Qian Mausoleum.

literal: On xinchou day, he traveled west.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor traveled west.

literal: In the intercalary ninth month, on guiyou day, Xing Baopu was ordered to audit Xian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On guiyou day in the intercalary ninth month Xing Baopu was ordered to audit Xian Mausoleum.

literal: On bingzi day, the march halted at the seashore.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the march halted at the seashore.

literal: On gengchen day, the Double Ninth, he climbed high at Camel Mountain and granted chrysanthemum wine to the ministers.
idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Double Ninth Festival, the Emperor climbed Camel Mountain and granted chrysanthemum wine to the ministers.

literal: On xinsi day, an edict instructed the eastern campaign generals to advance when the waters receded.
idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict instructed the eastern campaign generals to advance when the waters had receded.

literal: On bingshen day, Jurchen chancellor Jubuli came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Jurchen chancellor Jubuli came with tribute.

literal: On wuxu day, the court halted at Donggu Mountain.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the court encamped at Donggu Mountain.

literal: On jihai day, Susa memorialized that the Jubugu tribes had reached the near marshlands; yilijin Yilugu requested to carry out captive raids; the Emperor said, "These divisions have done no harm to the state — why carry out captive raids and needlessly stir up trouble.
idiomatic: On jihai day Susa reported that the Jubugu tribes had reached the near marshlands and yilijin Yilugu asked permission to raid for captives; the Emperor said, "These tribes have done the state no harm — why raid for captives and needlessly stir up trouble.

literal: " The request was denied.
idiomatic: " The request was denied.

literal: In winter, eleventh month, on jiaxu day, an edict ordered Prince of Wu Shao to oversee the burial rites of Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the eleventh winter month an edict put Prince of Wu Shao in charge of the burial rites for Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.

literal: On dingchou day, an edict ordered Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor Qipodili to comfort the border people.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor Qipodili to reassure the border population.

literal: On wuyin day, Princess Hugudian was granted gold and silk, artisans, and other goods for her husband's burial.
idiomatic: On wuyin day Princess Hugudian was granted gold, silk, artisans, and other goods for her husband's burial.
